description: List creator posts in a campaign (cursor paginated). Requires the read scope. Each engagement covers that post. engagement covers accepted videos only: ER = 100 * (likes + comments) / observed views; saves is separate. Preserve zero/null, erCoverage/savesCoverage and measurement timestamps. Use engagement.views for ER, not totalViews.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page (nextCursor).

status.description: Filter by post status, e.g. ACCEPTED.

name: vibevo_list_campaign_posts
title: List campaign posts
